title: AGS Policy Decision (audited)
description: The tamper-evident record of one governed action decision. Formalizes AGS principle #1 (the decision is deterministic and made outside the model, before the action runs) and #3 (tamper-evident, hash-chained audit). entry_hash = sha256(prev_hash + the canonical record without entry_hash), so any later edit breaks the chain.

agent_id.description: Verifiable per-agent identity (principle #2), not a shared key.
